description: Synthetic sesslint.seal parity (constants, hashing, build_entry, verify_lines, verify_ledger, sha256_file; no session payloads).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-seal-ledger-lock: append_seal and _ledger_lock use msvcrt.locking or fcntl.flock; Rust ledger_lock closes the sidecar and returns LockingUnavailable before append (not byte-compared here).
GAP-seal-resources: get_seal_schema_path and load_seal_schema import sesslint._resources.schema_path; Rust returns ResourcesUnavailable (not byte-compared here).

GAP-seal-verify-wide-json-integer: verify_lines on entries with integers outside the Rust codec range returns a canonical error in Rust; Python may still report chain divergence (not byte-compared here).
